entities.name: Savra vod Savo
entities.description: Matka (high priestess) of the Golgari Devkarin elves for two hundred years, secretly serving Szadek.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Golgari guild leader and Savra's brother.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Savra's hidden master who used her to gain control of four guilds and then killed her.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Golgari parun whose preserved body Savra revived; he later possessed her corpse.

entities.name: Sisters of Stone Death
entities.description: A trio of gorgons who took control of the Golgari.

entities.name: Lexya
entities.description: One of the Sisters of Stone Death, killed by Svogthir.

entities.name: Lydya
entities.description: One of the Sisters of Stone Death, killed by Svogthir.

entities.name: Ludmilla
entities.description: Remaining sister offered a chance to relinquish control.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild Szadek controlled by replacing its leaders with lupul.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild Savra joined via the Chorus of the Conclave.

entities.name: Decamillennial Festival of the Guildpact
entities.description: Festival during which Savra joined the Chorus and was killed.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: Simic creation of Momir Vig that battled Rakdos.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Daemonic parun of the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Szadek urges Savra to revive Svogthir; she proves her power over him and they team up against the Sisters of Stone Death.
events.quote: they teamed up to take down the Sisters of Stone Death

events.summary: Savra kills Svogthir and appoints herself guildmaster of the Golgari.
events.quote: Savra then killed Svogthir and appointed herself guildmaster.

events.summary: Szadek betrays Savra and brutally snaps her neck after she joins the Chorus of the Conclave.
events.quote: Savra was betrayed by Szadek, who brutally snapped her neck.

events.summary: Svogthir possesses Savra's body, which is later crushed in the battle between Project Kraj and Rakdos.
events.quote: her body was then possessed by the mind and spirit of Svogthir
